raw.details:
Guidelines:

  • Eligibility: Open to all undergraduate and postgraduate students across India.
  • Team Formation:
    • Inter-college team members are allowed.
    • Inter-specialization team members are allowed (Engineering, Design, MBA, etc.).
  • Team Size: 1–4 members per team.
  • Problem Statements: Open Innovation – participants can propose solutions to any major challenge in INDIA
  • Rounds & Duration:
    • Round 1 – Idea Submission (1 day): Teams submit a 10-slide PPT covering the problem statement, solution concept, tech stack, and team details.
    • Round 2 – Prototype Development (1 Day): Shortlisted teams build a working prototype/MVP and submit:
      • GitHub repository link with source code
      • 3–5 minute demo video
      • Presentation deck explaining features, workflow, and impact

Rules:

  • All submissions must be original work of the team.
  • Use of open-source libraries and public APIs is allowed.
  • Teams must respect intellectual property rights.
  • Plagiarized or copied ideas will lead to disqualification.
  • Teams must adhere to deadlines for each round.
  • Judges’ decision will be final and binding.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Innovation & Creativity
  • Technical Depth & Functionality
  • Practical Feasibility & Scalability
  • Clarity of Presentation & Demo

Rewards:

  • Top 3 teams: Excellence Certificates.
  • All Round 2 participants: Certificate of Participation.
